budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver two physically carried orders per courier before their deadlines, balancing private timeliness against shared traffic, charging, route commitments and energy assistance.
task.natural_termination: The episode naturally ends once every parcel is delivered or expired. Success means all eight were delivered; mixed outcomes remain explicit. Otherwise truncate at 128, with natural completion taking priority.
task.interaction: A bonded, expiring shared corridor reservation changes other robots legal routes. Opposite-side yielding accelerates admission, prevents the yielder entering the corridor, and can earn a credit only after a real partner crossing. Occupancy, mutually consented swaps, finite batteries and shared-capacity chargers create additional concrete resource and route dependencies.
task.observation_access: The complete board, positions, parcel contracts/status, energies, credits, requests, queue ages, binding commitments and leases are public; each role receives an identity one-hot. Intent becomes public through an actual paid request or binding yield state. No hidden policy-only observation is supplied by rendering.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Robot actually posted one service-credit bond for a timed route request
Robot began a binding yield commitment and relinquished any claim
Lease holder entered and exited the actual central corridor on the requested opposite side
A qualifying opposite-side yielder earned one credit after a partner really crossed
Robot actually transferred two battery units to a neighboring robot
Robot participated in a mutual-consent physical position swap
A waiting parcel became carried by its assigned robot
An actual carried parcel was unloaded at its exact target
An undelivered parcel passed its deadline and expired
All eight actual parcels were delivered

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
